sourceModifications: No upstream module edits; the host adapter embeds the fixed v8.0.38 module. Existing custom selector, host IPC/admission, quota recovery, no-refresh identities and synchronous pre-bootstrap Codex 408 EOF guard are retained. RequestRetry remains zero. This upgrade adds execution-order protection for active cooldowns, preserves independent model cooldowns beneath credential quota, reconciles replayed web_search_call declarations and preserves explicit parallel_tool_calls=false. Local identity, admission, quota and stream-commit boundaries remain owned by the adapter.

hostAdaptations.behavior: Retain conversion of only a nil stream result carrying the exact request-timeout Codex EOF sentinel into a 502 so the auth manager can try another admitted account before downstream commitment.
hostAdaptations.guard: An ordinary HTTP 408 response, non-matching error, or already-started stream is passed through unchanged.
hostAdaptations.validation: Synthetic loopback HTTP 200 empty-stream failover, single-account HTTP 408 preservation, partial-stream non-replay, and held-open terminal SSE completion tests; go test -race and go vet.

hostAdaptations.behavior: For policy_changed, busy or credentials_busy after a persisted reservation rollback, preserve the permanent admission tombstone and classify the abandoned tuple explicitly. A Go HTTP request skips that profile and tries other admitted profiles without repeating an impossible reservation until the acquire deadline. A new HTTP request may recover normally.
hostAdaptations.guard: Pre-reservation transient busy still waits; stopping, admission deadline, identity, quota, paid floor and not_participating refusal semantics remain unchanged. Never retry an already accepted or committed response.
hostAdaptations.validation: 436 native host checks, 248 Go race tests with 3 opt-in skips, go vet, and 58 isolated production Swift IPC plus Go loopback HTTP checks. No real provider or installed application validation.

desktopAdapterReference.use: CODEX_CLI_PATH stdio wrapper pattern; no Hazmat sandbox or server is included.

compatibility: Pinned internal executor/registry imports. The local module uses the upstream module's child namespace solely to satisfy Go internal import rules; it is an AiGoodBro adapter, not an upstream-maintained package.
rollback: Stop the optional proxy and leave it disabled; remove only this module's helper resource and isolated state when explicitly requested. Legacy dispatch, OAuth and account switching remain independent.

upstreamFixes.behavior: HTTP/2 closed-client connections do not cool credentials; this adapter keeps automatic request replay disabled.
Join multiline SSE data into complete JSON events in nonstream and streaming Codex execution, including bootstrap buffering.
Retain upstream-confirmed quota and RetryAfter on canceled execution or ready bootstrap error chunks; plain cancellation does not create cooldown.
Remove only out-of-range integer numeric schema bounds, preserving valid int64 limits, fractional values and user data.
Execution sequence watermarks prevent an older in-flight success from clearing a newer active model or credential cooldown.
Preserve independent model failures beneath propagated credential quota, including persisted wrap provenance; automatic Devin refresh behavior is not used by this Codex adapter.
Reconcile replayed web_search_call input items with tool declarations for Codex Responses requests.
Preserve an explicit parallel_tool_calls=false in OpenAI-to-Codex translators.

upstreamUpgradeReview.verification: git ls-remote tag and go mod download Origin independently resolve to the recorded commit; module sums verified. The upstream go.mod and MIT license are byte-identical between these releases.
upstreamUpgradeReview.requestPolicy: sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_request_scoped_errors.go is byte-identical. The local Codex unsupported-model stop rule and RequestRetry=0 remain in force.
upstreamUpgradeReview.authCompatibility: Result adds AccessToken and ExecutionSeq. Results must not be logged or serialized wholesale. RegistrationEpoch fencing remains; matching AccessToken may keep a result valid across a CredentialVersion change. The SDK adds Manager.Modify without removing Update. Local noRefresh identities do not adopt the new 96-hour automatic OAuth refresh lead.
upstreamUpgradeReview.cooldownCompatibility: CooldownStateRecord adds IndependentState and CredentialQuotaPropagated for the independent model layer beneath credential quota. Custom persistence and quota recovery must preserve independent failures and must not treat quota restoration as proof of network recovery.
upstreamUpgradeReview.streamCompatibility: The existing Codex bootstrap buffering and post-commit non-replay boundaries remain. Responses failures now preserve a sanitized response.failed envelope; replayed web_search_call history is reconciled with the declared tools.
upstreamUpgradeReview.dependencyValidation: go mod verify and go list -mod=readonly -deps -json . passed; 457 packages and 38 linked dependency modules. Adapter regression results are recorded separately from source inspection.
